og.alt: Hooks (@pyreon/hooks): 65 hooks. Zero cleanup code to write.

hero.alt: Schematic: a component mounts and four hooks attach a document listener, an interval timer, a ResizeObserver and online/offline listeners. When the component unmounts, all four are removed at once; the cleanup code you would write by hand is not needed.
